Documentation / Players

Build more. Repeat less.

Everything you need to turn a familiar block into a complete building palette—and use Chisel's construction tools without guesswork.

Chisel 26.1.2.18Minecraft 26.1.2NeoForge

Install Chisel

  1. Install NeoForge for Minecraft 26.1.2. Chisel is built for NeoForge and does not run on Fabric or Quilt.
  2. Add Chisel and CTM to the mods folder. CTM is a required library and must match the Minecraft version used by Chisel.
  3. Launch the game. Confirm both mods appear in the loaded-mod list before opening a world.
Match the versions exactly. A file marked “latest” may target a different Minecraft release. When reporting an issue, include the exact Chisel, CTM, NeoForge, and Minecraft versions.

Your first chisel

Craft an iron, diamond, or obsidian chisel and use it to open the Chisel menu. Place a supported block in the input slot, browse every variant in its family, and choose the pattern you want.

Preview first

Selecting a variant updates the preview. The input is converted only when you confirm the operation.

Search the family

Use the search field to find a variant by name or description when a family has a large catalog.

Work in stacks

Use the menu's bulk interaction to process matching blocks from your inventory when you are building at scale.

Keep the material

Variants within a family convert between one another; Chisel changes appearance, not the underlying material tier.

Chisel modes

In-world modes change the shape of the selection affected when chiseling placed blocks. Hold the configured mode-selection key, scroll to the mode you want, and release the key to select it. The world outline previews affected blocks before you act.

ModeBest for
SingleChanging one block with precise control.
RowHorizontal strips, trim, and long accents.
ColumnPillars and vertical architectural details.
PanelLarger flat surfaces such as walls and floors.
ShapelessConnected groups when a rectangular selection is not useful.

Tools beyond the chisel

Auto Chisel

Automates one conversion at a time. Supply input blocks, a template block from the same family, and a valid chisel. Finished blocks move into the output area, and item pipes can insert input and extract output.

Builder's Guide

Projects construction guides for shapes such as cubes, cylinders, and domes. Use it to establish the outline, then fill the visible positions with your chosen blocks.

Measuring Tape

Measures distances between blocks and displays the result in the world—useful for centering builds and keeping repeated sections consistent.

Offset Tool

Shifts the pattern used by supported vertical connected textures. The in-world indicator shows the direction of the next adjustment.

Troubleshooting

A block does not appear in the Chisel menu

The block may not belong to a registered variant family. In a modpack, the author can add compatible blocks through Chisel's family tags.

Connected textures are missing

Confirm CTM is installed, that Chisel and CTM target the same Minecraft release, and that connected textures are not being overridden by an incompatible resource pack.

The game crashed

Open an issue and include exact version numbers, the complete crash report or latest log, and an image when the problem is visual. Reproduce the issue without unrelated resource packs when possible.
